card.name: Painters' names in art biographies
card.fires_on: First names or name parts of famous painters and critics in art-history biographies, right before the surname (William, Charles, Jean, Claude). Also fires on linking words just before a list of master artists.

modes.label: First name of an artist
modes.description: A given name where the surname of a famous artist or critic is about to follow.
modes.example: introduced him to<< Charles>> Baudelaire, the first critic

modes.label: Words leading into artist lists
modes.description: A linking word such as 'of' or 'as' just before named European masters.
modes.example: learned the lessons<< of>> European masters—such as El Greco

card.writes: No clear link to the listed tokens; it seems to expect a surname of an artist next.
card.plain: It lights up on the first name of a famous painter in an art biography, just before the surname.
